**Finding submitted: `missing` (INSURANCE)**

**What I checked**
- Full-document searches for "insurance", "errors and omissions", "fidelity bond" — the only hits are Obligor insurance premiums billed to wireless accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance inside the "Qualified Institution" definition (p0903). Neither is a vendor insurance covenant.
- Article X (Miscellaneous) read in full — no insurance section; Article VI indemnity (p0291) reviewed as a potential mitigant.

**Why it fails the fallback**
Cellco, as Servicer and Custodian, collects payments, holds Receivable Files and processes Obligor account data for the Issuer and Depositor — a services provider touching our data. The only risk-transfer mechanism is the Servicer indemnity, which is capped in scope to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence and provides no insured capacity behind it. That sits below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and in the playbook's walk-away zone for a vendor processing personal data.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)**
New Section 10.14 in Article X at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, certificates on request), with self-insurance expressly permitted to reflect Cellco's credit standing and the Parent Support Agreement, and the fallback limits offered in the comment.
